thesis_text:
Bottom line: for Hudson River Trading (Quant/SWE, entry), your odds through the cold application alone are low, but not zero. This read rests on a curated-qualitative record as of 2026-10-12 with no population sample — treat every pattern below as reported, not measured. Postings frame the bar as exceptional quantitative and programming ability rather than finance knowledge: the winter programs are explicitly built for students without extensive quant-trading experience, while the summer and graduate postings require real programming depth (Python required for Algorithm Development; C++ valued for low-latency work). No GPA cutoff is stated in the postings checked.

Who gets in (sample N=not available — curated-qualitative record, as of 2026-10-12):
- This CIR is curated-qualitative: no population sample exists for it yet, so there are no percentages to show. What follows is the reported pattern from public sources, labeled as such.
Known biases of this data: Official postings and university reproductions show stated requirements and offers, not who is actually hired.; The strongest compensation evidence is a Summer 2026 posting; carrying it forward would be an assumption, so it is labeled by year.; Interview detail is community-reported and self-selected.. We see who got in, not who tried and failed — survivorship bias is real (§0).

What Hudson River Trading says it screens for vs what the record shows:
Stated: Demonstrated programming experience; familiarity with C, C++ , Python and/or Rust is preferred in the WiTTI posting. Experience with statistical analysis, numerical programming or machine learning in Python (Pandas/NumPy), R and/or MATLAB in the Algorithm Development posting.

The plan:

- Confirm this cycle's application window and deadlines for Hudson River Trading on the official careers page — dates move, and this CIR's cadence fact is the starting point, not the truth (§3.3). (by 2026-10-19)
- Apply to a first, reachable rung: a smaller employer in the same role family (the ladder pattern in this CIR's path patterns). Volume plus follow-up is the play. (by 2026-10-26)
